name: Topside
feature_notes: Owner Today opens with the complete business masthead visible after sign-in or session restoration. Scrolling belongs to the owner as soon as they interact.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Existing Countercraft backend is active; this build requires idle-v1 service and SQL upgrade before customer kiosk use. No Ike publication configured at read-only audit. Old service is rejected by kiosk.

install_step: Open the Owner Workspace from the Engine on iPad, sign in with AutoFill, and check that the entire branded header is visible before touching the page. Scroll down and check that it stays where you leave it.
